name: @forest/e2e
description: Forest end to end on devnet: the deployed host, registry payer, fee payer and programs, with its own issuer (a stand-in Didit) and index on loopback, since the deployed issuer is real and a script has no face. Two people from 24 words, each given a note by the loop issuer's face check, buying credits with test dollars, registered with a person proof (the seller through the registry payer with a credit, the buyer through the fee payer), paying the host in credits, assistants acting through the CLI (mcp/) with the keys each app makes (an offer with a photo, the seller's inbox opened, a reply, a request to the seller, until the seller makes its message key past and deletes its read key), a message to the seller's inbox, a payment through the escrow, reviews, the loop index showing it, and the seller proving its rating on its card.
